{{Futebol Sport}} |atualização = 3 de maio de 2025 }} '''Pedro Miguel Marques da Costa Filipe''' ([[Torres Novas]], [[14 de dezembro]] de [[1980]]), conhecido como '''Pepa''', é um [[treinador]] e ex-[[futebolista]] [[Portugueses|português]] que atuava como [[centroavante]]. Atualmente treina o [[Clube de Futebol Estrela da Amadora|Estrela da Amadora]] . É reconhecido por ser um líder firme e convicto, onde as equipes que orienta praticam um futebol atrativo, positivo e dominador. Suas características são conhecidas além das fronteiras e isso fez com que aos 41 anos agarrasse o primeiro desafio internacional, ao assumir o comando técnico do Al-Tai, da [[Arábia Saudita]].{{citar web|url=https://www.publico.pt/2022/07/19/desporto/noticia/pepa-vai-treinar-arabia-saudita-2014259|título=Pepa vai treinar na Arábia Saudita|data=19/07/2022|acessodata=03/09/2024|publicado=PÚBLICO}} Posteriormente, em 2023, foi convidado pelo ex-craque mundial [[Ronaldo Nazário|Ronaldo]] para treinar o [[Cruzeiro Esporte Clube|Cruzeiro]], um dos maiores clubes do [[Brasil]].{{citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/sportv/programas/boleiragem/noticia/2023/04/24/pepa-no-cruzeiro-ronaldo-revela-analise-de-seis-tecnicos-tres-argentinos-ate-a-definicao.ghtml|título=Pepa no Cruzeiro: Ronaldo revela análise de seis técnicos - três argentinos - até a definição|data=24/04/2023|acessodata=03/09/2024|publicado=ge}}{{citar web|url=https://www.mg.superesportes.com.br/app/noticias/futebol/cruzeiro/2023/04/25/noticia_cruzeiro,3993476/cruzeiro-conversou-com-seis-tecnicos-ate-escolher-pepa-revela-ronaldo.shtml|título=Cruzeiro conversou com seis técnicos até escolher Pepa, revela Ronaldo|data=25/04/2023|acessodata=03/09/2024|publicado=Superesportes|autor=Pedro Bueno}} == Carreira como jogador == Nascido em [[Torres Novas]], [[Distrito de Santarém]], Pepa ingressou nas categorias de base do [[Sport Lisboa e Benfica|Benfica]] em 1994, aos 13 anos. O atacante realizou sua estreia como profissional no dia 23 de janeiro de 1999, marcando numa vitória em casa por 3–1 contra o [[Rio Ave Futebol Clube|Rio Ave]], pela [[Primeira Liga]].{{citar web|url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-betclic/benfica/detalhe/pepa-marcou-golo-na-estreia|título=Pepa marcou golo na estreia|data=05/03/2002|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=[[Record (jornal desportivo)|Record]]}} Depois de ter sido apontado como uma jovem promessa, passou a jogar principalmente pela equipe B ([[Sport Lisboa e Benfica B|time reserva]]),{{citar web|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924085351/http://www.record.xl.pt/Arquivo/interior.aspx?content_id=104120|título=Equipas B: "Laboratório" ou "armazém"?|data=9 de novembro de 2001|acessodata=17 de junho de 2015|publicado=Record}} também sendo emprestado em março de 2000 ao [[Lierse SK|Lierse]], da [[Bélgica]].{{citar web|url=http://www.record.xl.pt/Futebol/interior.aspx?content_id=27785|título=Pepa cedido ao Lierse por uma época e meia|data=13 de março de 2000|acessodata=24 de setembro de 2014|publicado=Record|arquivourl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150711072144/http://www.record.xl.pt/Futebol/interior.aspx?content_id=27785|arquivodata=11 de julho de 2015|urlmorta=sim}}{{citar web|url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-betclic/benfica/detalhe/pepa-quero-voltar-ao-benfica|título=Pepa: «Quero voltar ao Benfica»|data=15/03/2000|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Record}} Em 2002, faltando quatro anos, Pepa rescindiu seu contrato com o Benfica e seguiu os passos dos colegas jovens Rui Baião e [[Jorge Ribeiro]]. Em seguida assinou com o [[Varzim Sport Club|Varzim]], decisão que mais tarde considerou o pior erro da sua vida.{{citar web|url=https://maisfutebol.iol.pt/pepa-em-retrospectiva-sair-do-benfica-foi-o-meu-maior-erro|título=Pepa em retrospectiva: «Sair do Benfica foi o meu maior erro»|data=31/12/2007|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Maisfutebol|autor=Nuno Travassos}} Por conta das várias lesões no joelho, o atacante encerrou a carreira no final de 2007, com apenas 26 anos.{{citar web|url=https://maisfutebol.iol.pt/pepa-em-entrevista-de-promessa-do-benfica-a-reforma-aos-26-anos|título=Pepa em entrevista: de promessa do Benfica à «reforma» aos 26 anos|data=31/12/2007|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Maisfutebol|autor=Nuno Travassos}}{{citar web|url=https://eternobenfica.blogspot.com/2011/01/pepa-dez-anos-depois.html|título=Pepa, dez anos depois|data=06/01/2011|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Eterno Benfica}} == Carreira como treinador == Em 2013, após dois anos a trabalhar com equipes de base do Benfica,{{citar web|url=https://maisfutebol.iol.pt/benfica/pepa/bruno-lage-ficou-com-um-carro-com-muito-cavalos-e-tem-maos-para-ele|título=«Bruno Lage ficou com um carro com muitos cavalos e tem mãos para ele»|data=28/03/2019|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Maisfutebol}} Pepa teve a sua primeira experiência como treinador principal, tendo sido nomeado para o [[Associação Desportiva Sanjoanense|Sanjoanense]] nas ligas regionais{{citar web|url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/detalhe/pepa-estou-obcecado-por-comecar-a-trabalhar-830035|título=Pepa: "Estou obcecado por começar a trabalhar"|data=28/06/2013|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Record}} e ajudando o clube a chegar à [[II Divisão|Terceira Divisão]] logo em sua primeira tentativa.{{citar web|url=http://www.record.xl.pt/Futebol/Nacional/seniores/interior.aspx?content_id=901097|título=Todos os plantéis da edição 2014/15 - Campeonato Nacional de Seniores|data=23 de agosto de 2014|acessodata=17 de junho de 2015|publicado=Record|arquivourl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150617081510/http://www.record.xl.pt/Futebol/Nacional/seniores/interior.aspx?content_id=901097|arquivodata=17 de junho de 2015|urlmorta=sim}} Em [[Segunda Liga de 2015–16|2015–16]] ele alcançou o mesmo feito com o [[Clube Desportivo Feirense|Feirense]] da [[Segunda Liga|LigaPro]], embora não tenha terminado a temporada depois de ser substituído por [[José Mota]] nos dois meses finais.{{citar web|url=https://tvi.iol.pt/noticias/ii-liga/14-05-2016/pepa-e-a-subida-do-feirense-correm-me-as-lagrimas-por-nao-estar-a-festejar|título=Pepa e a subida do Feirense: «Correm-me as lágrimas por não estar a festejar»|data=14/05/2016|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=[[TVI 24]]}} Pepa continuou a trabalhar na [[Sistema de ligas de futebol de Portugal|Primeira Divisão Portuguesa]] nos anos seguintes, com [[Moreirense Futebol Clube|Moreirense]]{{citar web|url=https://www.dn.pt/desporto/interior/pepa-e-o-novo-treinador-5184944.html/|título=Pepa é o novo treinador|data=20/05/2016|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=[[Diário de Notícias (Portugal)|Diário de Notícias]]}}{{citar web|url=https://desporto.sapo.pt/futebol/primeira-liga/artigos/pepa-ja-nao-e-treinador-do-moreirense|título=Pepa já não é treinador do Moreirense|data=21/11/2016|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=[[SAPO]]}} e [[Clube Desportivo de Tondela|Tondela]].{{citar web|url=https://www.ojogo.pt/futebol/1a-liga/tondela/noticias/interior/pepa-e-o-novo-treinador-do-tondela-5596947.html|título=Pepa é o novo treinador do Tondela|data=10/01/2017|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=[[O Jogo (jornal)|O Jogo]]}} Durante sua passagem de dois anos no último, ele evitou com sucesso o rebaixamento, mas não foi mantido.{{citar web|url=https://www.dn.pt/desportos/interior/pepa-deixa-de-ser-treinador-do-tondela-10935760.html/|título=Pepa deixa de ser treinador do Tondela|data=24/05/2019|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Diário de Notícias}} Tendo iniciado a temporada de 2019–20 sem clube, Pepa substituiu Filó no comando do [[Futebol Clube Paços de Ferreira|Paços de Ferreira]] após a quarta rodada, com o time em último na classificação da [[Primeira Liga de 2019–20|Primeira Liga]].{{citar web|url=https://www.ojogo.pt/futebol/1a-liga/pacos-ferreira/noticias/interior/pepa-e-o-novo-treinador-do-pacos-de-ferreira-11262343.html|título=Pepa é o novo treinador do Paços de Ferreira|data=02/09/2019|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=O Jogo}} Em maio de 2021, depois de os ter conduzido ao [[Primeira Liga de 2020–21|quinto lugar]] e à qualificação para [[Liga Conferência Europa da UEFA de 2021–22|a edição inaugural]] da [[Liga Conferência da UEFA|Liga Conferência Europa da UEFA]], deixou o ''[[Estádio Capital do Móvel|Estádio da Mata Real]]''.{{citar web|url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-nos/p--ferreira/detalhe/presidente-do-pacos-de-ferreira-confirma-saida-de-pepa-no-final-da-epoca|título=Oficial: Pepa deixa P. Ferreira no final da temporada|data=09/05/2021|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Record|autor=José Santos}}{{citar web|url=https://www.ojogo.pt/futebol/1a-liga/pacos-ferreira/noticias/pacos-de-ferreira-garante-o-quinto-lugar-no-campeonato-e-reage-desta-forma-curiosa-13714868.html/|título=Paços de Ferreira garante o quinto lugar no campeonato e reage desta forma curiosa|data=12/05/2021|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=O Jogo}} Dias depois de deixar o Paços, Pepa assinou contrato de três anos com o [[Vitória Sport Clube|Vitória de Guimarães]].{{citar web|url=https://desporto.sapo.pt/futebol/primeira-liga/artigos/pepa-confirmado-como-novo-treinador-do-v-guimaraes|título=Pepa confirmado como novo treinador do V. Guimarães|data=21/05/2021|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=SAPO}} Seu primeiro desafio internacional veio em 2022, quando foi anunciado pelo Al-Tai, da [[Campeonato Saudita de Futebol|Saudi-Pro League]], no dia 19 de julho.{{citar web|url=https://observador.pt/2022/07/19/pepa-ruma-ao-al-tai-da-arabia-saudita-e-treina-pela-primeira-vez-no-estrangeiro/|título=Pepa ruma ao Al-Tai da Arábia Saudita e treina pela primeira vez no estrangeiro|data=19/07/2022|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Observador}} Antes de rumar para a [[Arábia Saudita]], o técnico português conseguiu que duas equipes portuguesas retornassem às competições europeias. Primeiro o Paços de Ferreira e depois o Vitória de Guimarães, na temporada [[Primeira Liga de 2021–22|2021–22]]. Pepa também alcançou o 5º Lugar na [[Primeira Liga]] com o Paços de Ferreira, salvou o Tondela três vezes do rebaixamento e ainda conseguiu um acesso com o Feirense. === Cruzeiro === Foi anunciado pelo [[Cruzeiro Esporte Clube|Cruzeiro]] no dia 20 de março de 2023, substituindo [[Paulo Pezzolano]] no comando do clube mineiro.{{citar web|url=https://www.terra.com.br/esportes/cruzeiro/apos-saida-de-pezzolano-cruzeiro-anuncia-portugues-pepa-como-novo-treinador,598ca6d08270fba2b4360c442c03adb9j64railz.html|título=Após saída de Pezzolano, Cruzeiro anuncia português Pepa como novo treinador|data=20/03/2023|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Terra}} Dias depois de ser anunciado, adotou um discurso otimista e traçou planos ambiciosos, como as vagas nas competições internacionais e a briga pelo título da [[Copa do Brasil de Futebol de 2023|Copa do Brasil]].{{citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/futebol/times/cruzeiro/noticia/2023/03/24/tecnico-do-cruzeiro-pepa-minimiza-baixo-orcamento-e-sonha-com-vaga-em-sul-americana-ou-libertadores.ghtml|título=Técnico do Cruzeiro, Pepa minimiza baixo orçamento e sonha com vaga em Sul-Americana ou Libertadores|data=24/03/2023|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=ge}} Estreou pela equipe no dia 29 de março, com uma vitória por 3–2 em um amistoso contra o [[Red Bull Bragantino|Bragantino]].{{citar web|url=https://www.espn.com.br/futebol/artigo/_/id/11826007/cruzeiro-vence-red-bull-bragantino-de-virada-amistoso-estreia-pepa|título=Na estreia de Pepa, Cruzeiro vira para cima do Red Bull Bragantino e vence amistoso|data=29/03/2023|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=ESPN Brasil}} Sua estreia oficial foi no dia 13 de abril, em uma derrota por 1–0 para o [[Clube Náutico Capibaribe|Náutico]], nos [[Estádio Eládio de Barros Carvalho|Aflitos]], em jogo válido pela Copa do Brasil.{{citar web|url=https://www.mg.superesportes.com.br/app/noticias/futebol/cruzeiro/2023/04/13/noticia_cruzeiro,3992674/cruzeiro-peca-no-ataque-sofre-gol-no-fim-e-perde-para-nautico-nos-aflitos.shtml|título=Cruzeiro peca no ataque, sofre gol no fim e perde para Náutico nos Aflitos|data=13/04/2023|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Superesportes|autor=Luiz Henrique Campos}} Conquistou sua primeira vitória oficial no dia 22 de abril, um triunfo por 1–0 contra o [[Grêmio Foot-Ball Porto Alegrense|Grêmio]], no [[Estádio Raimundo Sampaio|Independência]], válido pelo [[Campeonato Brasileiro de Futebol de 2023 - Série A|Campeonato Brasileiro]].{{citar web|url=https://www.mg.superesportes.com.br/app/noticias/futebol/cruzeiro/2023/04/22/noticia_cruzeiro,3993332/cruzeiro-cria-muitas-chances-e-vence-o-gremio-pelo-brasileiro.shtml|título=Cruzeiro cria muitas chances e vence o Grêmio pelo Brasileiro|data=22/04/2023|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=Superesportes|autor=Thiago Madureira}} Após uma sequência ruim no Brasileirão, com direito a uma derrota por 3–0 para o Grêmio, Pepa foi demitido no dia 29 de agosto. No total, o treinador comandou o clube celeste em 25 partidas, com sete vitórias, oito empates e 10 derrotas — um aproveitamento de 38%.{{citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/futebol/times/cruzeiro/noticia/2023/08/29/pepa-e-demitido-pelo-cruzeiro.ghtml|título=Pepa é demitido pelo Cruzeiro|data=29/08/2023|acessodata=31/08/2024|publicado=ge}} === Al-Ahli === No dia 3 de outubro de 2023, Pepa foi anunciado como novo treinador do [[Al-Ahli Sports Club|Al-Ahli]], do [[Catar]].{{citar web|url=https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/esportes/futebol/cruzeiro/ex-cruzeiro-pepa-e-anunciado-e-comanda-treino-em-novo-clube/|título=Ex-Cruzeiro, Pepa é anunciado e comanda treino em novo clube|data=03/10/2023|acessodata=29/11/2024|publicado=CNN Brasil|autor=Leonardo Gimenez}} Antes da sua chegada, o clube ocupava a 10ª posição na [[Liga de Futebol do Catar|primeira divisão nacional]], com uma vitória e quatro derrotas. Após 14 partidas oficiais disputadas, entre jogos da liga e da [[Copa do Emir do Catar|Copa do Emir]], o português foi demitido no dia 8 de abril de 2024.{{citar web|url=https://www.itatiaia.com.br/esportes/futebol/cruzeiro/2024/04/08/ex-cruzeiro-tecnico-pepa-e-demitido-por-clube-do-catar|título=Ex-Cruzeiro, técnico Pepa é demitido por clube do Catar|data=08/04/2024|acessodata=29/11/2024|publicado=Itatiaia|autor=Leonardo Gimenez e Pedro Leite}} No total, Pepa obteve seis vitórias, dois empates e 11 derrotas, deixando o time na 9ª posição e nas semifinais da Copa do Emir.{{citar web|url=https://www.ojogo.pt/6729803068/pepa-fala-em-razoes-dificeis-de-aceitar-poderia-escrever-muita-coisa/|título=Pepa fala em "razões difíceis de aceitar": "Poderia escrever muita coisa..."|data=09/04/2024|acessodata=29/11/2024|publicado=O Jogo}} === Sport === Acertou com o [[Sport Club do Recife|Sport]] no dia 3 de setembro de 2024, retornando ao Brasil e assinando contrato até o fim da temporada.{{citar web|url=https://www.itatiaia.com.br/esportes/futebol/sport/2024/09/03/sport-oficializa-contratacao-do-tecnico-pepa-ex-cruzeiro|título=Sport oficializa contratação do técnico Pepa, ex-Cruzeiro|data=03/09/2024|acessodata=29/11/2024|publicado=Itatiaia|autor1=Nuno Krause|autor2=Guilherme Piu|autor3=Matheus Muratori}} Com a contratação oficializada, o português tornou-se primeiro treinador europeu da história do clube.{{citar web|url=https://www.esportesdp.com.br/noticias/futebol/sport/2024/09/sport-oficializa-contratacao-de-pepa-primeiro-europeu-a-treinar-o-clu.html|título=Sport oficializa contratação de Pepa, primeiro europeu a treinar o clube na história|data=03/09/2024|acessodata=29/11/2024|publicado=Diário de Pernambuco|autor=Haim Ferreira}}{{citar web|url=https://portaldeprefeitura.com.br/esportes/pepa-e-o-primeiro-treinador-portugues-a-comandar-o-sport/579681/|título=PEPA é o primeiro treinador PORTUGUÊS a comandar o SPORT|data=03/09/2024|acessodata=29/11/2024|publicado=Portal de Prefeitura|autor=Camilly Cardoso}} Pepa realizou sua estreia no dia 7 de setembro, numa vitória por 2–0 fora de casa contra o [[Avaí Futebol Clube|Avaí]].{{citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/pe/futebol/times/sport/noticia/2024/09/07/pepa-ve-missao-cumprida-em-estreia-pelo-sport-e-elogia-atletas-foram-bravos-coesos-unidos.ghtml|título=Pepa vê missão cumprida em estreia pelo Sport e elogia atletas: "Foram bravos, coesos, unidos"|data=07/09/2024|acessodata=29/11/2024|publicado=ge}} Sob seu comando, o ''Leão'' terminou a [[Campeonato Brasileiro de Futebol de 2024 - Série B|Série B]] na 3ª posição, com 66 pontos, e alcançou o principal objetivo no ano, que era o acesso para a Série A. Pepa conduziu a equipe em uma boa campanha no returno, com nove vitórias, quatro empates e apenas três derrotas.{{citar web|url=https://www.itatiaia.com.br/esportes/futebol/sport/2024/11/25/pepa-e-destaque-na-imprensa-de-portugal-apos-acesso-a-serie-a-com-o-sport|título=Pepa é destaque na imprensa de Portugal após acesso à Série A com o Sport|data=25/11/2024|acessodata=10/04/2025|publicado=Itatiaia|autor1=Nuno Krause|autor2=André Stehling}} Em abril de 2025, com a conquista do [[Campeonato Pernambucano de Futebol de 2025|Campeonato Pernambucano]] sob o [[Retrô Futebol Clube Brasil|Retrô]], o treinador levantou seu primeiro título na carreira.{{citar web|url=https://ne45.com.br/2025/04/03/sport-pepa-conquista-primeiro-titulo/|título=Pepa conquista seu primeiro título da carreira pelo Sport e torna-se o 12º treinador estrangeiro campeão pernambucano|data=03/04/2025|publicado=NE45|autor=Pedro Maranhão}} Um mês depois, no dia 3 maio, o Sport anunciou a demissão de Pepa após uma derrota por 2–1 para o [[Fluminense Football Club|Fluminense]], no [[Estádio Jornalista Mário Filho|Maracanã]]. O treinador não resistiu ao início ruim do ''Leão'' na [[Campeonato Brasileiro de Futebol de 2025 - Série A|Série A]], com cinco derrotas e dois empates em sete partidas.{{citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/pe/futebol/times/sport/noticia/2025/05/03/sport-demite-tecnico-pepa.ghtml|titulo=Sport demite o técnico Pepa|data=03/05/2025|publicado=ge|autor1=Daniel Leal|autor2=Camila Sousa}} == Origem do apelido == Pepa recebeu esse apelido ainda na infância, época em que era consumidor assíduo do refrigerante [[Pepsi]].{{citar web|url=https://www.leiaja.com/esportes/2024/09/02/conheca-pepa-o-primeiro-tecnico-europeu-a-comandar-o-sport/|título=Conheça Pepa, o primeiro técnico europeu a comandar o Sport|data=02/09/2024|acessodata=10/04/2025|publicado=Leia Já|autor=Felipe Holanda}} == Títulos como treinador == ;Sport *[[Campeonato Pernambucano de Futebol|Campeonato Pernambucano]]: [[Campeonato Pernambucano de Futebol de 2025|2025]] {{Referências}} == Ligações externas == *{{link|1=pt|2=https://br.soccerway.com/coaches/pedro-miguel-marques-da-costa-filipe/364401/|3=Pepa|4=no Soccerway}} {{Portal3|Futebol|Portugal|Biografias}} [[Categoria:Futebolistas de Portugal]] [[Categoria:Futebolistas do Sporting Clube Olhanense]] [[Categoria:Futebolistas do Futebol Clube Paços de Ferreira]] [[Categoria:Futebolistas do Varzim Sport Club]] [[Categoria:Futebolistas do Sport Lisboa e Benfica B]] [[Categoria:Futebolistas do Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] [[Categoria:Futebolistas do Lierse SK]] [[Categoria:Treinadores de futebol de Portugal]] [[Categoria:Treinadores do Vitória Sport Clube]] [[Categoria:Treinadores do Futebol Clube Paços de Ferreira]] [[Categoria:Treinadores do Moreirense Futebol Clube]] [[Categoria:Treinadores do Cruzeiro Esporte Clube]] [[Categoria:Treinadores do Sport Club do Recife]] [[Categoria:Portugueses expatriados na Arábia Saudita]] [[Categoria:Portugueses expatriados no Brasil]]

Marcos Leonardo.text:
{{Info/Futebol |nome = Marcos Leonardo |imagem = Marcos Leonardo apresentado ao Benfica em 2024 (cropped).jpg |imagem_tamanho = 250px |imagem_legenda = Marcos Leonardo pelo {{Futebol Benfica}} em 2024 |nome completo = Marcos Leonardo Santos Almeida |data de nascimento = {{dni|2|5|2003}} |local de nascimento = [[Itapetinga]], [[Bahia|BA]] |nacionalidade = {{BRAn|o}} |altura = 1,75 m{{Citar web|título= Marcos Leonardo|url=https://www.slbenfica.pt/pt-pt/futebol/plantel-principal/Leonardo-M?season=23-24|website= Sport Lisboa e Benfica|acessodata= 16 de Janeiro de 2025|urlmorta=sim|arquivourl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240316121627/https://www.slbenfica.pt/pt-pt/futebol/plantel-principal/Leonardo-M?season=23-24|arquivodata= 16 de Março de 2024}} |pé = [[destro]] |apelido = ML9
Menino da Vila |atividade = 2020–presente |clube atual = {{Futebol Ajax}} |número = 38 |posição = [[centroavante]] |base-ano1 = 2014–2020 |base-clube1 = {{Futebol Santos}} |ano1 = 2020–2023 |clube1 = {{Futebol Santos}} |jogos1 = 168 |gols1 = 54 |ano2 = 2023–2024 |clube2 = {{Futebol Benfica}} |jogos2 = 24 |gols2 = 8 |ano3 = 2024–2026 |clube3 = {{Futebol Al-Hilal}} |jogos3 = 81 |gols3 = 48 |ano4 = 2026– |clube4 = {{Futebol Ajax}} |jogos4 = 5 |gols4 = 0 |seleção-ano1 = 2019 |seleção1 = Brasil {{pequeno|Sub-16}} |seleção-jogos1 = 7 |seleção-gols1 = 3 |seleção-ano2 = 2021 |seleção2 = Brasil {{pequeno|Sub-18}} |seleção-jogos2 = 3 |seleção-gols2 = 3 |seleção-ano3 = 2022–2023 |seleção3 = [[Seleção Brasileira de Futebol Sub-20|Brasil {{pequeno|Sub-20}}]] |seleção-jogos3 = 8 |seleção-gols3 = 11 |seleção-ano4 = 2023 |seleção4 = [[Seleção Brasileira de Futebol Sub-23|Brasil {{pequeno|Sub-23}}]] |seleção-jogos4 = 1 |seleção-gols4 = 0 |clube-atualização = 20 de agosto de 2026 }} '''Marcos Leonardo Santos Almeida''' ([[Itapetinga]], [[2 de maio]] de [[2003]]) é um [[futebolista]] [[Brasileiros|brasileiro]] que atua como [[centroavante]] no {{Futebol Ajax}}.{{Citar web|url=https://english.ajax.nl/articles/marcos-leonardo-joins-ajax-from-al-hilal|titulo=Marcos Leonardo joins Ajax from Al-Hilal|acessodata=2026-08-20|website=english.ajax.nl|língua=en-US}} == Carreira == === Santos === A jovem promessa chegou às [[categorias de base]] do [[Santos Futebol Clube|Santos]] em agosto de 2014, aos 11 anos,{{Citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/times/santos/noticia/novo-raio-conheca-a-joia-do-santos-que-tem-media-de-mais-de-um-gol-por-jogo.ghtml|titulo=Novo raio? Conheça a joia do Santos que tem média de mais de um gol por jogo|data=2018-09-05|acessodata=2023-11-06|website=ge|lingua=pt-br|wayb=20251004191823}} por intermédio de uma franquia Meninos da Vila, na cidade de [[Taubaté]].{{Citar web|ultimo=sfcadmin|url=https://www.santosfc.com.br/conheca-marcos-leonardo-menino-da-vila-artilheiro-do-sub-15-do-santos-fc/|titulo=Conheça Marcos Leonardo, Menino da Vila artilheiro do Sub-15 do Santos FC|data=2018-09-13|acessodata=2023-11-06|website=Santos Futebol Clube|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20260217051208}} ==== Sub-13 e Sub-14 ==== Em 2015, foi o artilheiro do [[Campeonato Paulista de Futebol Sub-13|Campeonato Paulista Sub-13]] com 25 gols.{{Citar web|url=https://www.cbf.com.br/futebol-brasileiro/noticias/copa-brasil-sub17/artilheiro-da-base-santista-marcos-leonardo-ja-superou-ate-neymar|titulo=Marcos Leonardo: o artilheiro da base do Santos que superou Neymar|acessodata=2023-11-06|website=Confederação Brasileira de Futebol|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20251004192135}} Já no ano seguinte, quando jogou quantidade menor de jogos por estar no Sub-14, foi o vice-artilheiro com 21 gols, ficando atrás apenas de [[Kaio Jorge]], seu companheiro de clube que, na ocasião, marcou 22 gols. ==== Sub-15 ==== Em 2018, foi o artilheiro da Copa Nike, com nove gols em seis jogos, onde foi eleito também o melhor jogador do campeonato. Também representando o Santos na disputa do Jeju International Youth Tournament, na [[Coreia do Sul]], e retornou com sete gols anotados. Marcos Leonardo anotou 36 gols no [[Campeonato Paulista de Futebol Sub-15 de 2018|Campeonato Paulista Sub-15 deste ano]], quebrando o recorde da competição, que pertencia a outro santista: [[Yuri Alberto]].{{Citar web|url=https://www.diariodopeixe.com.br/noticias/marcos-leonardo-joia-de-15-anos-pode-ganhar-chance-na-copinha/|titulo=Marcos Leonardo, de 15 anos, pode ganhar chance na Copinha|acessodata=2023-11-06|website=Diário do Peixe|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20251004192733}} ==== Sub-17 ==== O jogador esteve em campo com a equipe Santista na [[Copa do Brasil de Futebol Sub-17 de 2018|Copa do Brasil Sub-17 no ano de 2018]], onde alcançou a semifinal. Na competição, Marcos foi um dos destaques tendo marcado 5 [[gol]]s na competição (dois a menos que o artilheiro [[João Pedro Junqueira Jesus|João Pedro]]).{{Citar web|url=https://www.cbf.com.br/futebol-brasileiro/competicoes/copa-brasil-sub17/2018|titulo=Tabela da Copa do Brasil Sub-17 2022|acessodata=2023-10-24|website=Confederação Brasileira de Futebol|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20240425001954}} O jogador também atuou pelo [[Campeonato Brasileiro de Futebol Sub-17|Campeonato Brasileiro Sub-17]] de 2019, onde sua equipe ficou pelo caminho ainda na primeira fase da competição.{{Citar web|url=https://www.cbf.com.br/futebol-brasileiro/competicoes/campeonato-brasileiro-sub17/2019|titulo=Tabela do Brasileirão Sub-17 2020|acessodata=2023-10-24|website=Confederação Brasileira de Futebol|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20231106231156}} ==== Sub-20 ==== No mesmo ano, o atacante dirigiu-se à equipe Sub-20 do Santos e disputou o [[Campeonato Brasileiro de Futebol Sub-20 de 2019|Campeonato Brasileiro Sub-20 de 2019]]. No entanto, a equipe continuou a fazer resultados ruins e foi eliminada ainda na primeira fase da competição.{{Citar web|url=https://www.cbf.com.br/futebol-brasileiro/competicoes/campeonato-brasileiro-sub20/2019|titulo=Tabela do Brasileirão Sub-20 2020|acessodata=2023-10-24|website=Confederação Brasileira de Futebol|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20240414015351}} No ano de 2019, por ambas as competições, o jogador marcou dois gols em oito partidas.{{Citar web|url=https://www.cbf.com.br/futebol-brasileiro/atletas/568013|titulo=Perfil do Atleta Marcos Leonardo do Santos-SP|acessodata=2023-10-24|website=Confederação Brasileira de Futebol|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20241211024850}} ==== 2020 ==== O jogador esteve disponível pela equipe santista durante a participação da equipe pela [[Copa São Paulo de Futebol Júnior de 2020|Copa São Paulo de Futebol Júnior]]. Com o jogo seguindo para os pênaltis, Marcos errou sua cobrança e viu a ''Macaca'' conseguir a classificação.{{Citar web|ultimo=gazetaesportiva|url=https://www.terra.com.br/esportes/ponte-preta/ponte-preta-vence-nos-penaltis-e-elimina-o-santos-na-copinha,ed9fe7ef58d6a8f513973631cafd5687x81lj46d.html|titulo=Ponte Preta vence nos pênaltis e elimina o Santos na Copinha|acessodata=2023-09-17|website=Terra|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20251004192331}} Após subir da base, assinando seu primeiro contrato profissional com 16 anos,{{Citar web|url=https://www.lance.com.br/santos/assina-primeiro-contrato-profissional-com-promessa-base.html|titulo=Santos assina primeiro contrato profissional com promessa da base|acessodata=2023-09-17|website=www.lance.com.br|lingua=pt-br|wayb=20250916122306}} o jogador passou a ser relacionado, ainda que sem entrar, a alguns jogos pelo treinador [[Cuca (treinador de futebol)|Cuca]]. Na ocasião, o jogador marcou um gol no empate em 1-1 contra o Athletico Paranaense (de outra jovem promessa, o [[Vitor Roque]]).{{Citar web|ultimo=gazetaesportiva|url=https://www.terra.com.br/esportes/santos/com-futuro-em-aberto-marcos-leonardo-chega-a-marca-de-150-jogos-pelo-santos,683549343ed9f8ffd830448374615e3b27grubl5.html|titulo=Com futuro em aberto, Marcos Leonardo chega à marca de 150 jogos pelo Santos|acessodata=2023-09-08|website=Terra|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20251004192113}} Seu futuro na equipe, até aquele momento, era incerto. [[Ángel Di María]] acertou a cobrança e trouxe a vitória ao time lusitano.{{Citar web|url=https://www.espn.com.br/futebol/partida/_/jogoId/691533/toulouse-benfica|titulo=Benfica 2-1 Toulouse (15 de fev, 2024) Placar Final - ESPN (BR)|acessodata=2024-06-28|website=ESPN|lingua=pt|wayb=20251004192130}} O Benfica, no entanto, sofreu uma eliminação nas quartas de final, quando não conseguiram superar o [[Olympique de Marseille]] em uma [[disputa por pênaltis]].{{Citar web|ultimo=jogada10|url=https://www.terra.com.br/esportes/futebol/internacional/olympique-de-marseille-elimina-o-benfica-nos-penaltis-e-vai-as-semifinais-da-europa-league,9e50859c7a184405a2002b433652e698jxzz0t43.html|titulo=Olympique de Marseille elimina o Benfica nos pênaltis e vai às semifinais da Europa League|acessodata=2024-06-28|website=Terra|lingua=pt-BR|wayb=20251004192855}} Leonardo não participou das cobranças por não ter entrado na partida, mas ele já tinha desperdiçado uma batida contra o [[Grupo Desportivo Estoril Praia|Estoril]] na Taça da Liga. === Al-Hilal === Após apenas um semestre, e 24 partidas com oito gols marcados, Marcos aceitou assinar com o [[Al-Hilal Saudi Football Club|Al-Hilal]], para jogar na [[Arábia Saudita]], em setembro de 2024. Os [[árabes]] pagaram uma quantia de 40 milhões de euros pelo atacante brasileiro.{{Citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/futebol/futebol-internacional/futebol-saudita/noticia/2024/09/02/al-hilal-anuncia-a-contratacao-de-marcos-leonardo.ghtml#:~:text=O%20Al-Hilal%20anunciou%20nesta,(R$%20250%20milh%C3%B5es).|titulo=Al-Hilal anuncia a contratação de Marcos Leonardo|data=2024-09-02|acessodata=2024-09-15|website=ge|lingua=pt-br|wayb=20260428003304}} O contrato assinado por Marcos teve a validade de cinco temporadas.{{Citar web|url=https://ge.globo.com/futebol/futebol-internacional/noticia/2024/09/01/al-hilal-acerta-contratacao-de-marcos-leonardo-do-benfica.ghtml|titulo=Al-Hilal acerta contratação de Marcos Leonardo, do Benfica|data=2024-09-01|acessodata=2024-09-15|website=ge|lingua=pt-br|wayb=20240906163623}} Marcos fez sua estreia pelo clube árabe em 14 de setembro, na vitória de 3-0 sobre o [[Al-Riyadh]]. '''José Francisco "Kikin" Fonseca Guzmán''' (born 2 October 1979) is a Mexican former professional [[association football|footballer]] who played as a [[striker (association football)|striker]].<ref name="Francisco 'Kikín' Fonseca no continuará en el Santos">{{cite web|last1=Jimenez|first1=Daniel|title=Francisco 'Kikín' Fonseca no continuará en el Santos|url=http://www.aldia.cr/futbol-costa-rica/Francisco-Kikin-Fonseca-adios-Santos_0_391160901.html|website=aldia.com|publisher=al dia|access-date=24 May 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150525040153/http://www.aldia.cr/futbol-costa-rica/Francisco-Kikin-Fonseca-adios-Santos_0_391160901.html|archive-date=25 May 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref> He currently works as a football analyst for [[Televisa Deportes Network]].

==Club career==
Born in [[León, Guanajuato|León]], [[Guanajuato]], Fonseca made his first division debut with [[La Piedad]] in the 2001 Invierno season. After two seasons with Piedad, in which he played mostly as a substitute, Fonseca moved to [[Pumas UNAM|Pumas]], where he emerged as a star. After impressive showing in the 2003 Apertura and Clausura, he cemented his place in the Pumas starting lineup in the 2004 Clausura, during which he helped lead Pumas to a championship. After helping Pumas to a second title in the 2004 Apertura season, he was transferred to Cruz Azul, having registered 25 goals in 81 appearances for Pumas. At the beginning of 2005, Fonseca moved to [[Cruz Azul]] in one of the biggest transfers in [[Sport in Mexico|Mexican]] [[Sports league|league]] history. In [[Cruz Azul]], he also was an important player playing 60 and registering 2 goals, help Cruz Azul reach the quarterfinals.

===Benfica===
On 27 July 2006, Fonseca signed a four-year contract with Portuguese club [[S.L. Benfica]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2006-07-27 |title=Fonseca hopes to soar with Eagles |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/01b7-0e6d952fcaac-b95e057e9a14-1000--fonseca-hopes-to-soar-with-eagles/ |access-date=2026-09-22 |website=UEFA.com |language=en}}</ref> Playing in only eight league games and scoring one goal (he also played in three cup games scoring two goals). His first goal at [[S.L. Benfica]] was on 21 December 2006 when he headed in a pass from [[Nuno Gomes]] against [[Belenenses]].
Kikin scored another two goals in a match of the 4th round of the [[Cup of Portugal|Taça de Portugal]] between [[Oliveira do Bairro SC]] and Benfica that ended 5–0.<ref>[http://www.slbenfica.pt/Info/Futebol/Noticias/noticiasfutebol_futslboliveirabairrocro_060107_41131.asp] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140102193928/http://www.slbenfica.pt/Info/Futebol/Noticias/noticiasfutebol_futslboliveirabairrocro_060107_41131.asp|date=2 January 2014}}</ref>

After a half season with Benfica, he was transferred to Mexico's UANL Tigres<ref>{{Cite web |title=Se concretó el pase de Francisco Fonseca a Tigres de la UANL - La Jornada |url=https://www.jornada.com.mx/2007/01/15/index.php?section=deportes&article=a02n1dep |access-date=2026-09-22 |website=www.jornada.com.mx}}</ref> for the start of the Clausura 2007.

==International career==
Fonseca was an emerging force at forward for the [[Mexico national football team|senior national team]]. On 2 April 2006, coach [[Ricardo Lavolpe]] selected him in the 23 man Mexican squad for the 2006 World Cup, in Germany. He scored his first goal in the [[2006 FIFA World Cup]] against [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]] and won the Man Of The Match Award given by FIFA in the defeat of Mexico versus Portugal. After being selected by [[Hugo Sánchez]] for the [[2007 Gold Cup]], Fonseca was dropped from the squad for the [[2007 Copa America]] due to his low performances and being shown the yellow card two consecutive games for un-called for fouls and complaints against refs. Despite an injury to star striker [[Jared Borgetti]], Fonseca declined invitation to the [[2007 Copa America]]. Even though he was Hugo's first choice, he took [[Luis Angel Landin]] instead. On 7 August 2008, Fonseca was called up to join Eriksson's second list of players, after an almost {{frac|1|1|2}}-year drought of not playing with the national team. He earned a total of 43 caps, scoring 21 goals.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/mex-recintlp.html Appearances for Mexico National Team] - RSSSF</ref>

==Personal life==
Fonseca appears on the North American cover of ''[[FIFA 07]]'' alongside [[Ronaldinho]] and [[Landon Donovan]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2006/08/12/fifa-07-kicks-off-with-seven-soccer-superstars-2 | title=FIFA 07 Kicks off with Seven Soccer Superstars | date=12 August 2006 }}</ref>

'''Pierre Laurent Robert''' (born 21 May 1975) is a former professional [[football player|footballer]] who played as a [[Midfielder#Winger|left winger]]. He was known for his powerful shot, particularly from [[Free kick (association football)|free kicks]].<ref name=avant/><ref name=analyst>{{cite news |last1=Furniss |first1=Matt |title=Most Free-Kick Goals in the Premier League |url=https://theanalyst.com/eu/2023/08/most-free-kick-goals-premier-league/ |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=Opta Analyst |date=14 August 2023}}</ref>

Born in [[Réunion]], he moved to mainland France aged 16 and began his professional career with [[Montpellier HSC|Montpellier]] and [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint Germain]], playing and scoring in the [[UEFA Champions League]] with the latter. In 2001, he transferred to [[Premier League]] club [[Newcastle United F.C.|Newcastle United]] for a £10 million fee, helping them qualify for several European tournaments including the semi-finals of the [[UEFA Cup]] in [[2003–04 UEFA Cup|2003–04]]. The following season, he was fined and disciplined for publicly criticising manager [[Graeme Souness]], leading to a loan to [[Portsmouth F.C.|Portsmouth]] and transfer to [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] in the Portuguese [[Primeira Liga]] in January 2006. He scored a winning free kick against ''[[O Clássico]]'' rivals [[FC Porto|Porto]] and played in a run to the Champions League quarter-finals, but moved on six months later to [[Levante UD|Levante]] in [[La Liga]]. He ended his career with brief spells at [[Derby County F.C.|Derby County]], [[Toronto FC]] and [[Athlitiki Enosi Larissa F.C.|Larissa]].

Robert played nine games for [[France national football team|France]] between 1999 and 2001, scoring one goal and winning the [[FIFA Confederations Cup]] in [[2001 FIFA Confederations Cup|2001]]. His younger brother [[Bertrand Robert|Bertrand]] also became footballer, as did his son [[Thomas Robert|Thomas]].

==Early and personal life==
Robert was born in [[Saint-Benoît, Réunion|Saint-Benoît]], Réunion.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/FootballFicheJoueur2907.html |title=Laurent Robert |newspaper=L'Équipe |location=Paris |access-date=28 December 2020 |language=fr}}</ref> His father was a local footballer, who shared his reputation for free kick goals.<ref name=avant>{{cite news |last1=Lemaître |first1=Clément |title=Laurent Robert : « Ma grosse frappe de balle du pied gauche est innée »|trans-title=Laurent Robert: "My hard left-foot strike is innate" |url=https://footdavant.fr/laurent-robert-ma-grosse-frappe-de-balle-du-pied-gauche-est-innee/ |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Foot d'Avant |date=10 August 2018 |language=French}}</ref> His younger brother [[Bertrand Robert|Bertrand]] was also a footballer, and also began his career at [[Montpellier HSC|Montpellier]] before spending most of it in Greece.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Haond |first1=Patrick |title=Robert had Spurs option |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/2340022/robert-had-spurs-option |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Sky Sports}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Stade Brestois. Bertrand Robert plante Brest pour la Grèce !|trans-title=Stade Brestois. Bertrand Robert leaves Brest for Greece!|url=https://www.letelegramme.fr/sports/toutes-les-infos/spanstade-brestoisspan-bertrand-robert-plante-brest-pour-la-grece-569892.php |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Le Télégramme |date=29 July 2009 |language=French}}</ref> His son [[Thomas Robert|Thomas]] signed for [[Airdrieonians F.C.|Airdrieonians]] in [[Scottish League One]] in 2020.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Grace |first1=Liam |title=Thomas Robert: Laurent Robert's son signs for Airdrieonians |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11781/12025130/thomas-robert-laurent-roberts-son-signs-for-airdrieonians |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Sky Sports |date=9 July 2020}}</ref> He is the brother of [[Fabien Robert]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Robert: I'm Happy To Be Here - News - Swindon Town |url=https://www.swindontownfc.co.uk/news/2015/july/robert-im-happy-to-be-here/ |access-date=2023-11-28 |website=www.swindontownfc.co.uk |language=en-gb}}</ref>

==Club career==
===Montpellier===
Robert played with the Réunion team that were French youth cup winners when he was 13, and league champions a year later. At 16, he moved to mainland France to play for [[Stade Brestois 29|Brest]]. Six months into his spell, the [[Brittany|Breton]] club filed for bankruptcy, and he moved to [[AJ Auxerre|Auxerre]] in December 1991. Shocked by the cold, he moved on one week later to [[Montpellier HSC|Montpellier]], so he could be with fellow Réunionnais goalkeeper [[Claude Barrabé]]; he was transported by former Montpellier player [[Fleury Di Nallo]] when Auxerre manager [[Guy Roux]] was absent.<ref name=avant/>

On 20 January 1996, Robert scored his first professional goal in a 2–0 home win over [[FC Martigues|Martigues]], having asked manager [[Michel Mézy]] to bring him on as a substitute to take the free kick. He came off the bench for the final 15 minutes on 11 February as his team were losing 2–0 at [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]], and assisted the first goal and scored the winner in a 3–2 victory that would cost his future employer the league title.<ref name=avant/>

===Paris Saint-Germain===
After scoring 11 goals in 32 games in [[1998–99 French Division 1|1998–99]], Robert was close to a transfer to [[Olympique de Marseille|Marseille]], but backed out when manager [[Rolland Courbis]] said that his strategy was to rotate all of his players, including French internationals [[Robert Pires]] and [[Christophe Dugarry]].<ref name=avant/> He then signed for PSG, who had finished the previous season in 9th.<ref name=avant2>{{cite news |last1=Lemaître |first1=Clément |title=Laurent Robert : « J'ai réalisé le match parfait lors de PSG-Rosenborg » |trans-title=Laurent Robert: "I pulled off a perfect match in PSG v. Rosenborg"|url=https://footdavant.fr/laurent-robert-jai-realise-le-match-parfait-lors-de-psg-rosenborg/ |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Foot d'Avant |date=11 August 2018 |language=French}}</ref>

Robert continued his reputation for free kicks at PSG, where he shared responsibilities with [[Éric Rabésandratana]]. On 4 May 2000, he netted one in a 3–0 home win over Montpellier from 30 metres out. In the [[2000–01 UEFA Champions League]], he scored once and assisted twice in a 7–2 win over [[Rosenborg BK|Rosenborg]] in what he called his "perfect match", as well as scoring a free kick against [[A.C. Milan]] in the second group stage in a 1–1 draw at the [[Parc des Princes]].<ref name=avant2/><ref>{{cite news |title=Mari answers Milan mayday |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/champions_league/1178327.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=20 February 2001}}</ref>

Halfway through the 2000–01 season, when Robert was the league's top scorer with 12 goals, manager [[Philippe Bergeroo]] was dismissed and replaced with [[Luis Fernandez]]. Robert did not get along with Fernandez and in 2018, he blamed his arrival for PSG's title challenge failing.<ref name=avant2/> In July 2001, Robert contributed to PSG winning the [[UEFA Intertoto Cup]], scoring four goals over the two legs of the second round against [[FC Jazz]] of Finland; he played as a forward due to injuries to [[Nicolas Anelka]] and [[Laurent Leroy]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Evans |first1=Nic |title=Robert talks on hold as PSG seek successor |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/2213469/robert-talks-on-hold-as-psg-seek-successor |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Sky Sports}}</ref>

===Newcastle United===
On 1 August 2001, Robert signed a five-year deal with [[Newcastle United F.C.|Newcastle United]] of the English [[Premier League]], for a fee of £10 million.<ref name=guardian>{{cite news |title=Newcastle clinch Robert signing |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2001/aug/01/newsstory.sport12 |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=The Guardian |date=1 August 2001}}</ref> [[Cup-tied]] for their Intertoto campaign,<ref name=guardian/> he made his debut on 19 August in the season opener away to [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]]; his 25-yard shot in a free-kick situation was spilt by goalkeeper [[Ed de Goey]], allowing [[Clarence Acuña]] to equalise in a 1–1 draw.<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea 1–1 Newcastle |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2001/aug/19/newsstory.sport21 |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=The Guardian |date=19 August 2001}}</ref> On 8 September, away to [[Tyne–Tees derby|rivals]] [[Middlesbrough F.C.|Middlesbrough]], he won a penalty from which goalkeeper [[Mark Schwarzer]] was sent off and [[Alan Shearer]] scored, assisted a goal by [[Nikos Dabizas]] and scored his own first goal in a 4–1 win.<ref>{{cite news |title=Tyne tears for Boro |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/1529913.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=8 September 2001}}</ref> A week later, his fifth-minute free kick opened a 4–3 win over three-times defending champions [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] at [[St James' Park]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Newcastle stun Man Utd |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/1543556.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=15 September 2001}}</ref> He scored five free-kick goals as Newcastle came fourth in 2001–02; as of August 2023, this remained a joint record alongside [[David Beckham]]'s five for Manchester United a season earlier.<ref name=analyst/> Robert's 11 free-kick goals in the Premier League ranks joint sixth in all-time ranking, and his average of 994 playing minutes per free-kick goal remains the best of any player with at least 8 such goals.<ref name=analyst/>

On 9 February 2003, Robert opened the scoring at home to defending champions [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] in the 53rd minute after receiving a pass from [[Gary Speed]] 35 yards out, but was sent off within five minutes for two yellow cards in a 1–1 draw. The second yellow card was for being too close to [[Dennis Bergkamp]]'s free kick, a decision for which Newcastle manager [[Bobby Robson]] took issue with referee [[Neale Barry]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Walker |first1=Michael |title=Robson fumes as red card halts Robert |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2003/feb/10/newsstory.sport2 |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=The Guardian |date=10 February 2003}}</ref> He built up a strong left-sided partnership with compatriot full-back [[Olivier Bernard]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=McCormick |first1=Sean |title=Olivier Bernard reflects on 'perfect' partnership with Laurent Robert down Newcastle's left side |url=https://www.chroniclelive.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/olivier-bernard-reflects-perfect-partnership-16046065 |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Evening Chronicle |date=1 April 2019}}</ref> In one match in 2003, his shot hit Bernard in the head and knocked him out; Bernard recovered and assisted a goal but had no memory of the event.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Cunningham |first1=Jack |title=I played against Barcelona in Champions League and was KO'd by Newcastle teammate – now I own pub and pull pints |url=https://talksport.com/football/1410564/newcastle-olivier-bernard-pub-landlord-barcelona-champions-league-premier-league-ko/ |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Talksport |date=2 May 2023}}</ref>

Robert was sent off in the 40th minute of a 2–2 draw at [[Everton F.C.|Everton]] on 13 September 2003.<ref>{{cite news |title=Ferguson haunts Newcastle |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/3194211.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=13 September 2003}}</ref> Three months later, he scored "two contenders for goal of the season" and took the two [[corner kick]]s from which [[Alan Shearer]] scored the other two goals in a 4–0 victory against [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]].<ref>{{cite news| url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/3249102.stm | work=BBC News | title=Newcastle thrash Tottenham | date=13 December 2003}}</ref>  In a run to the semi-finals of the [[UEFA Cup]], he scored against [[NAC Breda]], [[FC Basel]] and [[RCD Mallorca]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Robert hits late winner |url=https://www.independent.ie/sport/soccer/robert-hits-late-winner/25926521.html |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Irish Independent |date=16 October 2003}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Ameobi seals Newcastle's fightback |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2003/SPORT/football/11/06/uefa.england/ |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=CNN |date=6 November 2003}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Taylor |first1=Louise |title=Robert to the fore after Newcastle step on the pace |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2004/mar/12/match.sport2 |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=The Guardian |date=12 March 2004}}</ref>

In April 2005, Robert publicly criticised Newcastle as not being as good as the previous season, and expressed his displeasure at being substituted. Manager [[Graeme Souness]] deemed these comments to be selfish, as they preceded a UEFA Cup quarter-final against [[Sporting CP]] and an [[FA Cup]] semi-final against Manchester United.<ref>{{cite news |title=Souness blasts 'selfish' Robert |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/teams/n/newcastle_united/4443365.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=14 April 2005}}</ref> That June, when still contracted to Newcastle, he made two interviews in [[The Sun (United Kingdom)|''The Sun'']], in which he criticised Souness again. He said that the team would have won the UEFA Cup if the manager were intelligent, and said that [[Jermaine Jenas]] was going to leave because of problems with the manager. He was fined two weeks' wages for each interview, totalling £180,000.<ref>{{cite news |title=Newcastle hand Robert second fine |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/teams/n/newcastle_united/4632741.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=29 June 2005}}</ref>

===Portsmouth===
Following his time at Newcastle United and a falling out with the club, Robert moved to fellow Premier League team [[Portsmouth F.C.|Portsmouth]] in June 2005 on a year-long loan, with two additional years agreed following the completion of the loan. Portsmouth chief executive [[Peter Storrie]] said it was a permanent deal for an undisclosed fee with a release clause in case of relegation,<ref>{{cite news| url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/teams/p/portsmouth/4092122.stm | work=BBC News | title=Pompey say Robert deal permanent | date=19 June 2005 | access-date=7 May 2010}}</ref> but club chairman [[Milan Mandarić]] clarified the deal.<ref>{{cite news |title=Robert Pompey deal is a loan |url=https://www.rte.ie/sport/soccer/2005/0619/193670-portsmouth/ |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=RTÉ |date=14 June 2007}}</ref>

Robert made his debut on 13 August 2005 in a 2–0 home loss to Tottenham on the opening day,<ref>{{cite news |title=Portsmouth 0–2 Tottenham |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/4127030.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=13 August 2005}}</ref> and a week later scored his only goal of 17 Pompey appearances, in a 2–1 away loss to [[West Bromwich Albion F.C.|West Bromwich Albion]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/4148526.stm |title= West Brom 2–1 Portsmouth |publisher=[[BBC]] |date=20 August 2005 |access-date=1 September 2009}}</ref> On 29 October, he refused to sit on the substitutes' bench in a 4–1 win at [[Sunderland A.F.C.|Sunderland]]. It transpired that he was called up for the game as a late replacement for the injured [[Salif Diao]], but failed to communicate that he himself was injured until the game was due to begin; he was fined while manager [[Alain Perrin]] appreciated it was a mistake.<ref>{{cite news |title=Repentant Robert fined by Pompey |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2005/oct/31/newsstory.sport4 |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=The Guardian |date=31 October 2005}}</ref> He was sent off on 26 December in a 1–1 draw with [[West Ham United F.C.|West Ham United]] at [[Fratton Park]], after having set up the goal for [[Gary O'Neil]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Portsmouth 1–1 West Ham |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/eng_prem/4537522.stm |access-date=12 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=26 December 2005}}</ref> In his final game on 2 January 2006, he enraged manager [[Harry Redknapp]] by missing a late free kick that could have been passed for an equaliser in a 2–1 loss at [[Blackburn Rovers F.C.|Blackburn Rovers]].<ref name=lined>{{cite news |last1=Marshall |first1=Adam |title=Robert lined up for Benfica |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/2362042/robert-lined-up-for-benfica |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=Sky Sports}}</ref>

===Benfica===
On 4 January 2006, Robert signed a 2{{frac|1|2}}-year deal at [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] in the Portuguese [[Primeira Liga]]. He signed on a free transfer after being removed from Redknapp's plans.<ref>{{cite news |title=Benfica seal Robert switch |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2006/jan/04/newsstory.benfica |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=The Guardian |date=4 January 2006}}</ref> Media reports suggested that Robert was signed as a potential replacement for Benfica captain [[Simão Sabrosa]], a player in the same position who was heavily linked with a move to Liverpool.<ref name=lined/><ref>{{cite news |last1=Tulett |first1=Darren |title=Redknapp refit sends Robert flying to Benfica |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2006/jan/04/newsstory.portsmouth?CMP=gu_com |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=The Guardian |date=4 January 2006}}</ref>

On his first start on 11 January 2006, Robert scored in a 2–0 [[Taça de Portugal]] fifth round win at [[G.D. Tourizense|Tourizense]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Robert imita Eusébio|trans-title=Robert imitates Eusébio|url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-betclic/benfica/detalhe/robert-imita-eusebio |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Record |date=13 January 2006 |language=Portuguese}}</ref> His first of two league goals was the game's only at home to [[FC Porto|Porto]] in ''[[O Clássico]]'' on 26 February, a free kick past [[Vítor Baía]];<ref>{{cite news |title=Robert marcou o golo que tudo decidiu|trans-title=Robert scored the goal that decided everything|url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-betclic/benfica/detalhe/robert-marcou-o-golo-que-tudo-decidiu |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Record |date=26 February 2006 |language=Portuguese}}</ref> the other six days later equalised in a 2–1 win at nearby [[C.F. Estrela da Amadora|Estrela da Amadora]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Whelan |first1=James |title=Spanish giants fire warning shots |url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/soccer/arid-10075235.html |access-date=12 November 2023 |work=Irish Examiner |date=6 March 2006}}</ref> Later in March, he started in both legs of Benfica's Champions League last-16 win over title holders Liverpool.<ref>{{cite news |title=Laurent Robert está muy cerca de ser levantinista |trans-title=Laurent Robert is very close to being a Levante player|url=https://as.com/futbol/2006/07/08/mas_futbol/1152340028_850215.html |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=Diario AS |date=8 July 2006 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

===Levante===
On 11 July 2006, Robert moved to Spanish [[La Liga]] club [[Levante UD|Levante]] on a two-year deal, having chosen them over an offer from Turkey's [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]].<ref name=libertad>{{cite news |title=El Levante cierra el fichaje de Laurent Robert para las dos próximas temporadas|trans-title=Levante secure the signing of Laurent Robert for the next two seasons|url=https://www.libertaddigital.com/deportes/el-levante-cierra-el-fichaje-de-laurent-robert-para-las-dos-proximas-temporadas-1276283368/ |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=Libertad Digital |date=11 July 2006 |language=Spanish}}</ref> At his first press conference, he said "Everyone knows my game. I've been a professional for ten years and this year they will need two players to mark me".<ref>{{cite news |title=Laurent Robert afirma en su presentación que "harán 2 jugadores para marcarme"|trans-title=Laurent Robert affirms in his presentation that "they will need 2 players to mark me"|url=https://www.levante-emv.com/deportes/2006/07/11/laurent-robert-afirma-presentacion-haran-13698101.html |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=Levante-EMV |date=11 July 2006 |language=Spanish}}</ref> He was one of four Frenchmen to join the [[Valencia]]-based club that summer, alongside [[Laurent Courtois]], [[Frédéric Déhu]] and [[Olivier Kapo]].<ref name=libertad/><ref>{{cite news |title=Kapo junta-se a Laurent Robert no Levante|trans-title=Kapo joins Laurent Robert at Levante|url=https://www.record.pt/internacional/detalhe/kapo-junta-se-a-laurent-robert-no-levante?act=0&est=Aberto |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=Record |date=12 August 2006 |language=Portuguese}}</ref>

Substituted at half time on his debut in a 4–0 loss at [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]], he returned 14 weeks later as a substitute against [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] and assisted [[Álvaro (footballer, born 1977)|Álvaro]]'s headed equaliser in a 1–1 draw.<ref>{{cite news |title=El Levante, sin puntería|trans-title=Levante, without a cutting edge |url=https://www.lne.es/deportes/2006/12/18/levante-punteria-21960012.html |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=La Nueva España |date=18 December 2006 |language=Spanish}}</ref> Three days later on 20 December, he was sent off in a 2–1 loss at [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Vara |first1=Miguel Á. |title=Osasuna mete la quinta y Villarroel dice que se va|trans-title=Osasuna get fifth win in a row and Villarroel says that he is leaving|url=https://as.com/futbol/2006/12/21/mas_futbol/1166686038_850215.html |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=Diario AS |date=21 December 2006 |language=Spanish}}</ref> On 30 November 2007, with only 13 games to his name, he left by mutual consent.<ref>{{cite news |title=Laurent Robert abandona el Levante|trans-title=Laurent Robert leaves Levante|url=https://www.fichajes.com/a2376128238005502855-laurent-robert-abandona-el-levante |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=Fichajes.com |date=30 November 2007 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

===Derby County===
On 11 January 2008, Robert returned to the Premier League by signing for [[Derby County F.C.|Derby County]] for the rest of the season, after impressing manager [[Paul Jewell]] on his trial. He joined a club with 7 points from 21 games and ten points inside the relegation zone.<ref>{{cite news |title=Derby confirm signing of Robert |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/teams/d/derby_county/7174189.stm |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=11 January 2008}}</ref> He made his first of four appearances the following day in a 1–0 home loss to [[Wigan Athletic F.C.|Wigan Athletic]], being replaced by [[Marc Edworthy]] after 59 minutes.<ref>{{cite news |title=Derby 0–1 Wigan |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/7172806.stm |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=12 January 2008|first=David|last=McIntyre}}</ref> The Rams finished the season with an all-time low of 11 points from 38 games.<ref>{{cite news |last1=de Cosemo |first1=Harry |title=Derby County 2007-08: 'We threw the towel in' - the story of the Premier League's worst team |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/55948890 |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=12 January 2021}}</ref>

===Toronto FC===
On 2 April 2008, Robert had his Derby contract cancelled by mutual consent and moved to [[Toronto FC]] in [[Major League Soccer]]. He had worked with their head coach [[John Carver (footballer)|John Carver]] at Newcastle.<ref>{{cite news |title=Robert leaves Derby for Toronto |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/teams/d/derby_county/7324508.stm |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=2 April 2008}}</ref> He played 17 league games – all bar one as a starter – and scored once on 19 April from a free kick against [[Real Salt Lake]] for the only goal of their first home game of the season.<ref>{{cite news |title=Toronto FC prevails in its home opener |url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/sounders/soccer-toronto-fc-prevails-in-its-home-opener/ |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=The Seattle Times |date=20 April 2008}}</ref> After what the [[Canadian Broadcasting Corporation]] described as "a series of uneven and uninspired performances", he was waived on 19 August.<ref>{{cite news |title=Robert's short career with TFC comes to an end |url=https://www.cbc.ca/sports/soccer/robert-s-short-career-with-tfc-comes-to-an-end-1.695771 |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=CBC |date=19 August 2008}}</ref>

===Larissa===
On 27 August 2008, Robert signed a two-year deal at [[Athlitiki Enosi Larissa F.C.|Larissa]] of [[Super League Greece]]. He reunited with former Newcastle teammates [[Nikos Dabizas]] and [[Nolberto Solano]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Voinikas |first1=Fotis |title=Larissa snap up Robert |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/4058103/larissa-snap-up-robert |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=Sky Sports |date=27 August 2008}}</ref> He terminated his deal a year early, saying it was because Greece was "a bit special", returned to Paris for family reasons and trained with PSG's reserves in the summer of 2009.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Martin |first1=Alexandre |title=Interview de Laurent Robert|trans-title=Interview with Laurent Robert |url=https://www.interviewsport.fr/robertlaurent.php |access-date=13 November 2023 |work=Interview Sport |date=20 November 2009 |language=French}}</ref>

==International career==
Robert appeared nine times for [[France national football team|France]], making his debut against [[Northern Ireland national football team|Northern Ireland]] on 18 August 1999, as a 55th-minute substitute in a 1–1 draw. He was the first person from Réunion to play for France.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Saffer |first1=Paul |title=French ambitions fire Robert |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/019b-0e6c102714a8-cb90285314b9-1000--french-ambitions-fire-robert/ |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=UEFA |date=24 March 2004}}</ref> He scored his only goal for his country on 15 November 2000 in a 4–0 win over [[Turkey national football team|Turkey]], again off the bench in another away friendly.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.insidesoccer.net/toronto-fc-signs-french-midfielder-laurent-robert/|title=Inside Soccer|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110726005931/http://www.insidesoccer.net/toronto-fc-signs-french-midfielder-laurent-robert/|archive-date=26 July 2011}}</ref> 

Robert was selected in the France team that won the [[2001 FIFA Confederations Cup]] in South Korea and Japan.<ref>{{cite news
 |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/1379790.stm
 |title=Classy France outplay Japan 
 |date=10 June 2001 
 |publisher=BBC Sport 
 |access-date=12 April 2012 
 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140326101049/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/1379790.stm
 |archive-date=26 March 2014
 |url-status=live
}}</ref> He started in the 1–0 loss to [[Australia men's national soccer team|Australia]] in the second group game, for which a completely new squad was picked by manager [[Roger Lemerre]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Australia stun France |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/1361503.stm |access-date=13 November 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=1 June 2001}}</ref>

==Coaching career==
After his retirement from football, Robert returned to his former club, [[Montpellier HSC|Montpellier]], where he began working as a forward coach within the clubs academy and women's section.<ref>[https://www.mhscfoot.com/articles/2015-2016/info-club/laurent-robert-le-nouveau-but-de-sa-vie Laurent Robert, le nouveau but de sa vie], mhscfoot.com, 29 October 2015</ref> A position he left in July 2020.<ref>[https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Montpellier-robert-nouzaret-a-la-retraite-laurent-robert-part-aussi/1131671 Montpellier : Robert Nouzaret à la retraite, Laurent Robert part aussi], lequipe.fr, 3 May 2020</ref><ref>[https://espritpaillade.com/2023/02/01/mhsc-psg-que-devient-il-laurent-robert/ [MHSC-PSG] QUE DEVIENT-IL ? LAURENT ROBERT], espritpaillade.com, 1 February 2023</ref>

==In film==
Robert's goal against Liverpool in the 2004–05 season at [[St James' Park]] is used as the winner against the same team in ''[[Goal! (film)|Goal!]]''. Character [[Santiago Muñez]] ([[Kuno Becker]]) strikes it and it zooms out as Robert's free kick hits the top corner. In ''[[Goal! 2: Living the Dream...]]'', his overhead kick against Fulham is featured as Muñez's goal at the start.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://inbedwithmaradona.com/journal/2017/3/6/laurent-roberts-flawed-genius-at-newcastle|title=LAURENT ROBERT'S FLAWED GENIUS AT NEWCASTLE|website=IBWM}}</ref>

'''Hans-Jörg Butt''' ({{IPA|de|hans ˈjœʁk ˈbʊt}}; born 28 May 1974), often simply called '''Jörg Butt''', is a German former [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[Goalkeeper (association football)|goalkeeper]].

Known for taking [[Penalty kick (association football)|penalty kick]]s,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/33006305|title=Rogerio Ceni: Sao Paulo keeper into club record books|publisher=BBC|date=4 June 2015|access-date=3 April 2016}}</ref> and for often running into the opposing penalty box in an attempt to find a winner whenever his team were trailing,<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport3/worldcup2002/hi/team_pages/germany/squad/newsid_1952000/1952434.stm|title=Hans-Joerg Butt|date=7 May 2002 |publisher=BBC Sport|access-date=15 January 2018}}</ref> he scored 26 [[List of goalscoring goalkeepers|goals]] in the [[Bundesliga]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.fussballdaten.de/spieler/butthansjoerg/ | title = Jörg Butt | publisher=Fussballdaten|language=de| access-date =22 March 2009}}</ref> He played for [[Hamburger SV]], [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen|Bayer Leverkusen]] and [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] in his country, having arrived at Munich already aged 34.

Butt represented [[Germany national football team|Germany]] in two [[FIFA World Cup|World Cups]] and at [[UEFA Euro 2000|Euro 2000]].

== Personal life ==

Butt was born in [[Oldenburg (city)|Oldenburg]]<ref name=BayernProfile/> and raised in nearby [[Großenkneten]],<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.welt.de/print-welt/article500868/Hans-Joerg-Butt-Die-nuechterne-Besessenheit-zwischen-den-Torpfosten.html |title=Hans Jörg Butt – Die nüchterne Besessenheit zwischen den Torpfosten |trans-title=Hans Joerg Butt – The sober obsession between the goal posts |language=de |newspaper=Die Welt |first=Peter |last=Glauche |date=5 February 2000 |access-date=8 August 2012}}</ref> where his father Jochen ran a company manufacturing [[Yard ramp|loading ramps]] and industrial doors.<ref name=Spiegel>{{cite news |url=http://www.spiegel.de/spiegel/print/d-17166974.html |title=Vater des Sieges |trans-title=Father of victory |language=de |magazine=Der Spiegel |first=Jörg |last=Kramer |date=21 August 2000 |access-date=8 August 2012}}</ref> As a youngster, he played for the junior teams of his local football club, TSV Großenkneten, as a [[forward (association football)|striker]].<ref name=Spiegel/>

Butt is married to Katja. As of November 2010, the couple had three children – a daughter and two sons.<ref name=BayernProfile>{{cite web |url=http://www.fcbayern.t-com.de/en/teams/profis/00392.php|title=Jörg Butt|publisher=FC Bayern Munich|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101107073709/http://www.fcbayern.telekom.de/en/teams/profis/00392.php |archive-date=7 November 2010}}</ref>

== Club career ==

=== Hamburg/Leverkusen ===
Butt started his professional career with modest [[VfB Oldenburg|Oldenburg]], achieving promotion to the [[2. Bundesliga|second division]] in 1996.<ref>{{Cite web | url = https://www.rsssf.org/players/hjbuttdata.html | title = Hans-Jörg Butt - Matches and Goals in Bundesliga | first = Matthias | last = Arnhold | date = 16 August 2018 | website = [[RSSSF]] | access-date = 24 August 2018 }}</ref> He moved to [[Hamburger SV|Hamburg]] in the 1997 summer and, in [[1998–99 Bundesliga|his second season]], scored seven goals for the team – all from the [[Penalty kick (association football)|penalty spot]] – adding nine in similar fashion [[1999–2000 Bundesliga|the following campaign]].

Butt joined [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen|Bayer Leverkusen]] on a [[Free transfer (association football)|free transfer]] in 2001, being the side's undisputed starter in the subsequent campaigns (he only missed one [[Bundesliga]] match in his first five seasons combined and added seven goals), and appeared in all the games (17) for a team that lost to [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] in the [[2001–02 UEFA Champions League]] [[2002 UEFA Champions League Final|final]], scoring a penalty in a 3–1 home win against [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] in the second group stage.

In [[2003–04 Bundesliga|2003–04]], after scoring a penalty in an away match against [[FC Schalke 04|Schalke 04]] on 17 April 2004, Butt turned away from midfield and began to enthusiastically celebrate with his teammates. He did not notice the whistle for the restart of the game and continued to celebrate. Schalke player [[Mike Hanke]] took the opportunity to shoot from the halfway line and scored while Butt was still jogging back to his position.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96j711uSIM |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211221/R96j711uSIM |archive-date=2021-12-21 |url-status=live|title= 2 Goals in a 30 Seconds Amazing  |date=12 August 2006 |publisher=[[YouTube]]| access-date =5 February 2011}}{{cbignore}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.kicker.de/schalke-gegen-leverkusen-2004-bundesliga-635319/analyse | title =Schalke verliert weiter an Boden|trans-title=Schalke falls further to the ground  |publisher=[[Kicker (sports magazine)|Kicker]]| date = 17 April 2004 | access-date =24 August 2010 | language = de}}</ref>

=== Benfica ===
After losing Leverkusen's nets to the young [[René Adler]] during the [[2006–07 Bundesliga|2006–07 season]], Butt decided to cancel the contract that linked him to the club until 2009, activating a clause that allowed him to leave the club should he fail to appear in more than half of the games during the second half of the campaign.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/news/newsid=533325.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121026132759/http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/news/newsid=533325.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=26 October 2012|title=Butt logs off at Leverkusen|website=[[UEFA]] |publisher=Union of European Football Associations |access-date=28 May 2008|date=30 April 2007}}</ref> In July 2007, he signed a two-year deal with Portuguese club [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/01c3-0e6e673ae49f-8a2bb3e810d0-1000--butt-begins-benfica-career/|title=Butt begins Benfica career|website=[[UEFA]] |publisher=Union of European Football Associations |access-date=17 July 2007|date=17 July 2007}}</ref>

Butt made his ''Eagles'' debut in the summer tournament of ''[[Guadiana Trophy|Torneio de Guadiana]]'', held between Benfica, [[Sporting CP]] and [[Real Betis]]. In the competition, he saved a penalty against Betis, helping Benfica with the final win. At the [[Lisbon]] outfit, however, he played understudy to [[Portugal national football team|Portuguese international]] [[Quim (footballer, born 1975)|Quim]], being used in the [[Taça de Portugal|domestic cup]] [[2007–08 Taça de Portugal|matches]]. He only made one [[Primeira Liga|league]] appearance for Benfica, coming on as a [[Substitute (association football)|substitute]] after Quim was [[Ejection (sports)|sent off]] against [[C.S. Marítimo]] in October 2007 – in this match, he saved a penalty from [[Ariza Makukula]] with his first touch of the game, and his team eventually won 2–1.

=== Bayern Munich ===
[[File:Hans Jörg Butt 3279215575 a6913d6d1d o.jpg|Butt with Bayern in 2009|thumb|left|240px]]
On 4 June 2008, Butt signed a two-year contract with [[2007–08 Bundesliga|reigning champions]] [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] and was expected to act as backup to [[Oliver Kahn]]'s heir, highly rated young [[Michael Rensing]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/news/newsid=705469.html|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130205005239/http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/news/newsid=705469.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=5 February 2013|title=Butt returns to Germany with Bayern |website=[[UEFA]] |publisher=Union of European Football Associations|date=4 June 2008|access-date=22 March 2009}}</ref> He made his official debut for the club in the [[2008–09 UEFA Champions League|Champions League round-of-16 second leg]] against [[Sporting CP]] in a 7–1 home drubbing, on 10 March 2009. With Rensing dropped to the bench following a 5–1 loss at [[VfL Wolfsburg|Wolfsburg]], he also started the remaining games of [[2008–09 Bundesliga|the season]], as the initial first-choice was also nursing a [[hand]] injury.

After the team's poor start to the [[2009–10 Bundesliga|2009–10 season]] with Rensing in goal, Butt was reinstated as the first-choice. On 8 December 2009, he scored his first goal for the club, a crucial penalty in the club's last [[2009–10 UEFA Champions League|Champions League group stage match]] at Juventus, coming from behind to a 4–1 victory – after this feat, he has managed to score a goal against Juventus in the Champions League for all three major German clubs he represented.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fcbayern.com/en/news/2009/12/three-out-of-three-for-butt-against-juve|title=Three out of three for Butt against Juve|publisher=[[FC Bayern Munich]]|date=9 December 2009|access-date=12 December 2009}}</ref>

On 30 January 2010, Butt missed out on the opportunity to score his first league goal for Bayern as his penalty was saved by [[1. FSV Mainz 05]]'s [[Heinz Müller (goalkeeper)|Heinz Müller]], but it proved to be of no detriment to the club as it won 3–0. On 16 February, he was rewarded for an outstanding season with a contract extension until 2011.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fcbayern.t-com.de/en/news/news/2010/22360.php?fcb_sid=70fd1cf02774ef70af28d94f90f34cd4|title='I think some very good times lie ahead'|publisher=FC Bayern Munich|date=16 February 2010|access-date=16 February 2010}}</ref> He was also in goal for the [[2010 UEFA Champions League Final|Champions League final]], where his team was denied an historic [[Treble (association football)|treble]] after losing 0–2 to [[Inter Milan]].

Midway through the [[2010–11 Bundesliga|2010–11 season]], 36-year-old Butt lost his starting place to another club youth graduate, [[Thomas Kraft]]. However, a series of unconvincing displays by the youngster, including a 2–3 home loss against Inter Milan in the [[2010–11 UEFA Champions League|Champions League Round of 16]] on 15 March 2011, and a 1–1 away draw with [[1. FC Nürnberg]] on 9 April, paved the way for the veteran to return to the starting line-up, which happened on 17 April, in a 5–1 home victory over former club Bayer Leverkusen, and he still appeared in 30 official games during the campaign (23 in the league), as his team finished in third position.

On 3 May 2011, Butt signed a one-year extension to his contract with Bayern,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fcbayern.t-com.de/en/news/news/2011/29324.php?fcb_sid=b74b8801d7a49813d519c0d4a7ad2125|title='Another year for Butt, Kraft on the move'|publisher=FC Bayern Munich|date=3 May 2011|access-date=8 May 2011}}</ref> backing up newly signed [[Manuel Neuer]]. He retired at the end of [[2011–12 Bundesliga|the season]] at the age of 38, after a [[Exhibition game|friendly]] with the [[Netherlands national football team|Netherlands]] on 22 May 2012 in which he acted as [[Captain (association football)|captain]].

== International career ==
[[File:Hans-Jörg Butt 2010 (cropped).jpg|thumb|Butt with Germany at the [[2010 FIFA World Cup|2010 World Cup]]]]
Butt was [[Germany national football team|Germany]]'s third-choice goalkeeper, behind [[Oliver Kahn]] and [[Jens Lehmann]], at both the [[UEFA Euro 2000]] and the [[2002 FIFA World Cup]], remaining an unused substitute in both tournaments.

He won three international [[Cap (sport)|caps]] for Germany in friendly matches, his debut coming against [[Liechtenstein national football team|Liechtenstein]] on 7 June 2000, where he appeared for the second half of an 8–2 routing.

Butt, [[Manuel Neuer]] and [[Tim Wiese]] were chosen as Germany's goalkeepers for the [[2010 FIFA World Cup|2010 World Cup]], with Butt taking the place of former Leverkusen teammate [[René Adler]], who had to withdraw due to a [[rib]] injury.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fcbayern.t-com.de/en/news/news/2010/23348.php?fcb_sid=915507b3a641f7e61bb625c6e1eaafc9|title=Eight FCB men in Löw's provisional squad|publisher=FC Bayern Munich|date=6 May 2010|access-date=7 May 2010}}</ref> He made his only competitive international appearance on 10 July, appearing in the [[2010 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Third place play-off|3–2 win]] against [[Uruguay national football team|Uruguay]] in the tournament's third-place playoff.<ref>{{Cite web | url = https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/hjbutt-intl.html | title = Hans-Jörg Butt - International Appearances | first = Matthias | last = Arnhold | date = 16 August 2018 | website = [[RSSSF]] | access-date = 24 August 2018 }}</ref>

== Post-retirement ==

Butt was appointed head of the [[Bayern Munich Junior Team]] on 1 July 2012.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.fcbayern.telekom.de/en/news/news/2012/35205.php|title=Club bids official farewell to Butt & Co|publisher=FC Bayern Munich|date=22 May 2012|access-date=23 May 2012}}</ref> He left the position on 7 August, stating "I misjudged this field of activity, for which I've had responsibility for a few weeks now. I approached my new appointment with great enthusiasm, but I have realised that the task does not offer the satisfaction and passion I wanted. This is the reason for my decision. I would like to thank FC Bayern for their understanding."<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.fcbayern.telekom.de/en/news/news/2012/36265.php|title=Butt to leave FCB youth development post|publisher=FC Bayern Munich|date=7 August 2012|access-date=7 August 2012}}</ref>
